scope: Ten AI PM and ten commercial PM fictional target-role cards; different candidate backgrounds are transfer cases, not engineering job targets.
reference_method: A separate Codex authoring agent saw frozen taxonomy and input fixtures only, not earlier predictions or performance. Root checked schema, source quotations, taxonomy IDs and coverage before prediction. AI authorship is not independent human ground truth.
chronology: Expansion added after the original ten-case exploratory results were known to root. Inputs and references are fixed before these new predictions, not before the original experiment. Preserve phase-specific and pooled descriptive results.
student_review_scope: Confirmed personal check applies to original RLV2F-01..10 only, after their run. No personal review asserted for RLX20-01..20.

metrics.case_agreement: cases with at least two matching IDs / 20; abstentions zero

pooling: Record-level pool original10 + expansion20, 30 unique profiles, 15 AI PM +15 commercial PM. Report phase differences. Not an original single preregistered 30-case holdout.
